meta.basis: Designed for the KijaniSpace demo, 28 Sep 2026. Working name; confirm with BRELA and the Play Store before branding. Contrast verified by the token generator (zero failures).

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: The ground behind everything. Cards sit on it.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs and table bodies. The only surface that carries content.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: table headers, empty states, the offline banner. Never carries critical readings.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons. Also the outline colour of the focus ring on the sun theme.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, units. Meets 7:1 on page and card so it stays readable outdoors; do not lighten it.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative: never the only signal of state.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: The boundary of an interactive control (inputs, toggles, secondary buttons). Clears 3:1 against the page.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Identity and the primary action: one primary button per screen, the active tab, the selected row. Doubles as text/icon colour because it clears 7:1 on page and card.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-wash
tokens.usage: Tint behind a selected item or brand icon. Carries primary text at full contrast.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: A low-chroma brand tint used for decoration and empty-state art. Never a state colour, never text.

tokens.name: on-tint
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a tint fill.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy / verified / synced, as TEXT or ICON. 7:1 on page and card.

tokens.name: ok-fill
tokens.usage: Healthy, as a FILL: gauge bars and dots. Pair with a label; never colour alone.

tokens.name: ok-wash
tokens.usage: Tint behind an OK badge or row.

tokens.name: watch
tokens.usage: Needs attention soon, as TEXT or ICON. Amber text is dark brown here so it clears 7:1; the bright amber is only ever a fill.

tokens.name: watch-fill
tokens.usage: Attention, as a FILL: gauge segments and dots.

tokens.name: watch-wash
tokens.usage: Tint behind a Watch badge or row.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Act now / failed, as TEXT or ICON. 7:1 on page and card.

tokens.name: critical-fill
tokens.usage: Critical, as a FILL: gauge segments and dots. A destructive button is an outline in the critical text colour, never a filled red.

tokens.name: critical-wash
tokens.usage: Tint behind a Critical badge or row.

tokens.name: note
tokens.usage: Neutral information, links, as TEXT or ICON. Not a state.

tokens.name: note-fill
tokens.usage: Neutral information as a FILL.

tokens.name: note-wash
tokens.usage: Tint behind an informational note.

tokens.name: offline-bg
tokens.usage: The offline banner ground. Offline is a normal state, not an error, so it uses a neutral surface with a strong border rather than red.

tokens.name: offline-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on the offline banner.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and switch-access focus. Drawn as a 3px outline with 2px offset.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal and bottom-sheet backdrop.

tokens.name: src-manual
tokens.usage: Provenance: the number was typed in by a person. Always shown with a hand icon and the word "Manual".

tokens.name: src-sensor
tokens.usage: Provenance: the number came from an IoT device or the Space-IoT Box. Always shown with a sensor icon and the word "Sensor".

tokens.name: src-satellite
tokens.usage: Provenance: the number came from Earth Observation or agro-climate data. Always shown with a satellite icon and the word "Satellite".

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First chart series. Every chart mark clears 3:1 against the card.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth chart series; neutral, used for comparison or baseline lines.

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen title on Home. One per screen.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Dissolved oxygen is 6.1 mg/L. Record again tomorrow to keep your record complete.
styles.usage: Default text. 17sp: read at arm's length in daylight.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis; the main line of a list row.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, units, provenance tags. The floor: nothing smaller than 13.

styles.name: figure-hero
styles.usage: A single reading the farmer must not miss: dissolved oxygen, the loan limit. Tabular.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between two touch targets (Android guidance: 8dp).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows inside a card; input inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter and default card padding. The workhorse.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding where the card is the screen's main subject.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between unrelated groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a new major section; bottom safe padding above the tab bar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, the tab pill.

size.note: Fixed dimensions. Targets are for touch first.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Smallest interactive target (Android 48dp, WCAG AAA 44px). No control is smaller.

tokens.name: touch-primary
tokens.usage: Height of the primary button and of list rows that navigate. Sized for wet or gloved hands.

tokens.name: tab-bar-height
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar, above the system inset.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icon inside a chip or badge.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icon beside a label.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icon that stands alone or heads an empty state.

tokens.name: stroke-control
tokens.usage: Border width on interactive controls. Outdoors a 1px hairline vanishes.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus outline width.

tokens.name: stroke-sun
tokens.usage: Border width on the sun theme.

shadow.note: Outdoors, shadows vanish. Elevation is drawn with a 1.5px border and a surface step; the only shadow is on bottom sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and menus only.
